The '''Emerald Splendor Estates''' were a set of large luxury houses located on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. 

== History ==
[[Byss/Legends|Byss]] was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Vergence/Legends|conduit]] that exponentially amplified the flow of the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]. [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] used the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to strengthen his body and mind, and to slow its decay. The Force demanded balance, and the conduit on Byss demanded [[Force drain/Legends|life energy]] to take in order to give energy to Sidious.<ref name=":0">[[Evasive Action: Recruitment|''Evasive Action: Recruitment'']]</ref>

Shortly after the [[Declaration of the New Order]], thousands of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from reconquered [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] worlds were transferred to Byss for sinister construction projects such as the [[Emperor's Citadel|Emperor's citadel]] and the Emerald Splendor Estates. [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Employment Center DA4176]] exclusively hired [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] as construction workers to alleviate what they claimed was an "emergency luxury housing crisis for [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] benefactors". The workers were [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|paid]] half in advance and were told they would only work for a few weeks. In reality, Byss was a one-way trip for aliens to slavery, and the workers' belongings were disintegrated instead of loaded onto the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]]. As the enslaved Separatists and alien workers constructed the Emperor's retreat, he fed off their life energy.<ref name=":0" /> Meanwhile, Emerald Splendor Estates was secretly advertised to [[Noble/Legends|aristocrats]] and the Emperor's most wealthy supporters across the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] as a recolonization effort to a hidden paradise. While these immigrants were kept distracted with bread and circuses, Palpatine drained their Force energy to sustain himself.<ref name=":1">[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|''Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji'']]</ref> 

After [[Tannon Praji/Legends|Tannon Praji]] secured his position in the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], he took a leave to relocate his wife [[Maree Praji|Maree]] and his daughter [[Onnelly Praji|Onnelly]] to the Emerald Splendor Estates<ref name=":1" /> for what they believed would only be a month or so.<ref name=":0" />

[[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] survivors [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]] and [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]] attempted to attain honest employment at the Coruscant Employment Center. Lo'gaan was ushered out of the aliens-only line and into [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]], while Zonder was hired as a construction worker for the Emerald Splendor Estates. Lo'gaan learned the alien workers were being tricked into slavery and rescued Zonder and three workers from the departure shuttle.<ref name=":0" />
